items.title: Leicester trust cuts cystoscopies with at-home GALEAS Bladder urine test
items.summary: University Hospitals of Leicester NHS Trust is piloting GALEAS Bladder, a non-invasive home urine test analysing 23 genes associated with bladder cancer, and has reduced the number of patients needing a cystoscopy as a result.

items.title: Galeas Bladder urine DNA test detected 92.2% of bladder cancers in seven-trust NHS study
items.summary: A urine DNA test, Galeas Bladder (Nonacus Ltd), detected 92.2% of bladder cancers among patients referred for investigation, identifying 71 of 77 cancers in 964 patients including 35 of 36 high-grade cancers and every muscle-invasive case.
